<!--
Frozen image style. This is a template, not a starting point — the style is
decided once and reused, so the blog's images read as one set rather than as
eight separate experiments.

The pipeline substitutes {{SUBJECT}} and {{BACKGROUND}} and sends the rest
verbatim to gpt-image-1 at 1536x1024. Everything below the marker line is the
prompt. Edit this file to change the house style; do not change it per post.
-->

Black ink pen line art. Hatching and cross-hatching for all shading — no colour
anywhere in the drawing itself, only black ink.

The background is a flat {{BACKGROUND}} field with a regular dot grid filling
the entire frame, edge to edge. No page edges, no notebook binding, no ruled
lines, no paper texture, no border — the dot grid runs off every side of the
image.

One scene, occupying roughly the middle 60% of the frame, with the dot grid
clearly visible on all four sides of it.

The subject: {{SUBJECT}}

Show the subject from behind or in profile. No human faces are visible
anywhere in the image.

The linework is deliberately imperfect — the hand of a competent amateur who
draws often, not a professional illustrator. Slightly uneven lines, honest
proportions.

No text, no lettering, no labels, no captions, no signature. The only exception
is a real logo or mark that is itself part of the concept.

A light hatched shadow on the ground under the subject.

Landscape orientation.
